title: ChatMessageEntry.hasMention must be optional
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-push-00 (jmap-chat-spec f0fda4c): hasMention and mentionScopes are optional and MUST be omitted when encrypted is true. crate-jmap-chat-types/src/push.rs:115 has_mention: bool fails to deserialize such entries. Make Option<bool>. Fix together with JMAP-51lu (has_mention_all -> mentionScopes).
